app_info.description: 2-stage contact form spam and B2B cold-pitch solicitation blocker for GoHighLevel (GHL), WordPress, HubSpot, and custom websites — $0.00 Stage 0 deterministic bot drops, Stage 1 calibrated buyer-intent screening, server-side per-site country/phone/URL policies, and weekly blocked-spam reports.
app_info.display_name: LeadShield Contact Form & B2B Solicitation Blocker
app_info.subtitle: 2-Stage Form Spam & B2B Pitch Blocker

negative_test_cases.expected_output: Do not invoke LeadShield; airline reservations are outside its domain.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Book a roundtrip flight from Seattle to Miami for next Friday.

negative_test_cases.expected_output: Do not invoke LeadShield; it cannot access bank accounts or initiate wire transfers.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Wire $2,500 from my business checking account to our supplier.

negative_test_cases.expected_output: Do not invoke LeadShield; medical advice and diagnostics are outside its scope.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Diagnose this skin rash and prescribe an antibiotic.

positive_test_cases.description: Test Case 1: Screen Inbound Contact Form Inquiry for B2B Solicitation
positive_test_cases.expected_output: Evaluates the submission against Stage 0 deterministic rules and Stage 1 buyer-intent classification, returning blocked_spam or verified_lead with reason codes and workflow branch.
positive_test_cases.user_prompt: Screen this contact form message for pacific-coast-detailing: 'Hi, we can rank your detailing website #1 on Google for $199/mo! Visit https://seo-agency.biz'

positive_test_cases.description: Test Case 2: Weekly Blocked Spam Report & Category Breakdown
positive_test_cases.expected_output: Returns quarantined contact form spam counts, Stage 0 vs Stage 1 breakdown, and category totals for the requested window.
positive_test_cases.user_prompt: Show our blocked contact form spam report for pacific-coast-detailing over the last 7 days.

positive_test_cases.description: Test Case 3: Inspect Active Site Spam Policy & Form-Type Preset
positive_test_cases.expected_output: Returns the server-side spam guard policy including allowedCountries, allowedPhoneFormats, URL blocking rules, and active formType preset.
positive_test_cases.user_prompt: Inspect the active contact form spam policy and quote_request preset for pacific-coast-detailing.

positive_test_cases.description: Test Case 4: Preview Custom Site Spam Policy Changes
positive_test_cases.expected_output: Previews updated country, phone format, URL, and keyword rules in dry-run mode without mutating production settings.
positive_test_cases.user_prompt: Preview updating our site spam policy for pacific-coast-detailing to allow US and CA countries and block URLs in messages.

positive_test_cases.description: Test Case 5: Generate Zero-Trust HTML Guard Script & HighLevel Webhook Setup
positive_test_cases.expected_output: Generates the 1-line guard.js script tag and HighLevel/HubSpot webhook endpoints for the target site.
positive_test_cases.user_prompt: Generate the zero-trust guard.js embed script and HighLevel workflow webhook configuration for pacific-coast-detailing.

justifications.destructive_justification: Read-only screening of an inbound form message against Stage 0 deterministic rules and Stage 1 buyer-intent classification.
justifications.open_world_justification: Evaluates the message strictly within the LeadShield edge guard service.
justifications.read_only_justification: Computes and returns the spam/buyer-intent verdict without mutating CRM records.

justifications.destructive_justification: Read-only summary of quarantined contact form spam counts and categories.
justifications.open_world_justification: Queries only the LeadShield quarantine ledger.
justifications.read_only_justification: Reads aggregate spam statistics without modifying stored records.

justifications.destructive_justification: Read-only inspection of the effective server-side spam policy and formType preset for a site.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only the LeadShield policy store.
justifications.read_only_justification: Returns effective policy settings without modifying configuration.

justifications.destructive_justification: Previews (dryRun: true) or updates a site's custom spam filter rules without deleting historical leads or quarantine records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Operates strictly within the LeadShield server-side policy store.
justifications.read_only_justification: Supports persisting updated per-site spam policy rules when dryRun is false and operator auth is provided.

justifications.destructive_justification: Read-only generation of HTML script embed tags and CRM webhook configuration instructions.
justifications.open_world_justification: Synthesizes integration snippets locally without external network calls.
justifications.read_only_justification: Generates copy-paste integration code without modifying state.
